notes:
What's new in 0.1.141:
- Shared with you: opening a library that another home shared with you no longer ends on the sign-in page of that home ("Your username / Your password"). If the shared page tries to reload itself without its pass, Beebo now closes that window instead, so pressing Open again starts fresh. Nothing on the other home changes.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite was run on the release source (2,176 test files, 22,256 tests): 22,110 passed and 0 failed (one test failed once and passed when run again); 109 tests in 34 files were skipped, so they were not run (mostly checks that need Linux, file links, an optional browser package or an opt-in switch), and 37 are marked as future work. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed 0.1.141 yet, so its change and its in-app update from 0.1.140 have not been tried by a person.
- Release source commit 2ae1942db.
- Built: Nov 23, 2026, 8:05 PM Eastern.
- Published: Nov 23, 2026, 9:26 PM Eastern.
